question: Can the current coupled runtime finish short practical bugfix plus documentation tasks?
qualification: Strict all-file qualification: native baseline, changed edit, exact fresh checks, accepted authored completion, independent original tests, exact roles and budgets, only declared changed files.
controls: Broken baseline, known reference repair, source-only documentation omission, tampered tests, equivalent non-identical repair, bounded role/transport receipt checks.
hypothesis: Smaller source and explicit visible behavioral contracts may permit useful complete loops. This is task scoping, not a causal runtime improvement experiment.
comparability: New authored development tasks; do not compare their pass rate directly with full-repository recovery tasks.
post_run: Retain all four outcomes, first divergence, candidate diffs and request counts. Any further live intervention needs a separate frozen wave.
